patch.value: GH-715: expose mutation-guard policies through canonical config help and output

The shipped mutation_guard settings can be changed only through an undocumented underscore key absent from config contracts and help. Add canonical dashed keys and typed policy/value domains, retain legacy aliases, expose effective values in bounded config reads, and align CLI, SDK contracts, completion, and documentation.

config help, contracts, and completion advertise canonical mutation-guard keys and allowed value domains; Legacy underscore keys remain compatible and normalize to the canonical settings leaves; Config list and export expose effective guard posture without leaking protected content; CLI, SDK, MCP, documentation, and temporary-project acceptance pass full gates
